epigaea.translation: [网络] 蔓地莓属；落后的杨梅；地不容

epigaeous.definition: a. Growing on, or close to, the ground.

epigamy.translation: 裂殖生殖, 裂配生殖

epigastric.definition:
a. of or relating to the anterior walls of the abdomen
a. lying on or over the stomach

epigastric center.translation: [医] 腹[上皮区]反射中枢(脊髓), 腹腔丛

epigastric vein.translation:
un. 腹壁静脉
[网络] 腹壁上静脉

epigastrium.definition: n. the region lying on or over the stomach (just below the sternum)
epigastrium.translation:
n. 上腹部
[医] 上腹部

epigeal.translation: a. [动]生长在地上的, 贴地生长的,浅水生长的

epigean.translation: [医]土表的, 地上生的, 地上的

epigene.definition:
a. Foreign; unnatural; unusual; -- said of forms of crystals
   not natural to the substances in which they are found.
a. Formed originating on the surface of the earth; -- opposed
   to hypogene; as, epigene rocks.

epigenesis.definition: n. a geological change in the mineral content of rock after the rock has formed
epigenesis.translation:
n. 后成, 渐成说
[医] 渐成说

epigenesist.definition:
n. One who believes in, or advocates the theory of,
   epigenesis.

epigenetic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to the epigenesis; produced according
   to the theory of epigenesis.

epigenotype.translation: 后生型, 总发育体系

epigenous.translation: a. [植](真菌)上面生的,生长于叶面的

epigeous.translation: a. [植]真菌上面生长的,生长于叶面的

epiglottic.definition: a. Pertaining to, or connected with, the epiglottis.

epiglottides.definition: n. a flap of cartilage that covers the windpipe while swallowing
epiglottides.translation: n. 会厌( epiglottis的复数形式 )

epiglottis.definition: n. a flap of cartilage that covers the windpipe while swallowing

epiglottises.definition: n. a flap of cartilage that covers the windpipe while swallowing
epiglottises.translation: n. 会厌( epiglottis的复数形式 )

epiglottitis.definition: n inflammation of the epiglottis; characterized by fever and a severe sore throat and difficulty in swallowing

epignathous.definition:
a. Hook-billed; having the upper mandible longer than the
   lower.

epigone.definition: n. an inferior imitator of some distinguished writer or artist of musician
epigone.translation: n. 追随者, 模仿者

epigones.definition:
plural of epigone
n. an inferior imitator of some distinguished writer or artist of musician
epigones.translation: (epigone 的复数) n. 追随者, 模仿者

epigonic.translation: (哲学、文艺等方面)后继者的, 追随者的, 模仿者的

epigonus.translation: n. 追随者, 模仿者

epigram.translation: n. 警句, 讽刺短诗

epigrammatic.definition: s terse and witty and like a maxim
epigrammatic.translation: a. 警句的, 讽刺的

epigrammatical.definition:
Writing epigrams; dealing in epigrams; as, an
   epigrammatical poet.
 Suitable to epigrams; belonging to epigrams; like an
   epigram; pointed; piquant; as, epigrammatic style, wit, or sallies of
   fancy.
epigrammatical.translation: a. 多警句的, 满是警句的；爱用警句的

epigrammatically.definition:
adv. In the way of epigram; in an epigrammatic
   style.

epigrammatism.translation: n. 警句文体, 警句的使用

epigrammatist.definition: n. One who composes epigrams, or makes use of them.
epigrammatist.translation: n. 警句家, 讽刺诗人

epigrammatists.definition:
plural of epigrammatist
n. One who composes epigrams, or makes use of them.
epigrammatists.translation: (epigrammatist 的复数) n. 警句家, 讽刺诗人

epigrammatize.definition: v. t. To represent by epigrams; to express by epigrams.
epigrammatize.translation:
vi. 写成警句
vt. 以讽刺诗形式写

epigrammatized.translation: v. 写成警句, 以讽刺诗形式书写( epigrammatize的过去式和过去分词 )

epigrammatizer.definition: n. One who writes in an affectedly pointed style.

epigrammatizing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Epigrammatize
epigrammatizing.translation: v. 写成警句, 以讽刺诗形式书写( epigrammatize的现在分词 )

epigrams.translation: n. 机智的短诗, 警句, 讽刺诗( epigram的复数形式 )

epigranular.translation: 等粒状的, 粒度均匀的

epigraph.definition:
n. a quotation at the beginning of some piece of writing
n. an engraved inscription
epigraph.translation: n. 碑文, 题铭, 题词

epigrapher.translation: 碑铭研究家, 金石学家

epigraphics.definition: n. The science or study of epigraphs.
epigraphics.translation: a. 碑文的, 碑铭的, 铭文的, 刻文的；碑铭研究的

epigraphist.definition: n. A student of, or one versed in, epigraphy.

epigraphs.definition:
plural of epigraph
n. a quotation at the beginning of some piece of writing
n. an engraved inscription
epigraphs.translation: (epigraph 的复数) n. 碑文, 题铭, 题词

epigraphy.definition: n. the study of ancient inscriptions
epigraphy.translation: n. 碑文, 题铭, 碑铭研究, 金石学

epiguanine.translation:
[化] 表鸟嘌呤
[医] 7-甲基鸟[便]嘌呤

epigynous.definition:
a. Adnate to the surface of the ovary, so as to be
   apparently inserted upon the top of it; -- said of stamens, petals,
   sepals, and also of the disk.
